yves-salomon.types: Yves Salomon is not a cashmere grade. Track the house trademark, the garment type such as coat, shearling or knit, and the generic material on the ticket so you do not collapse a furrier house into a single fiber class. This atlas treats the trademark as educational vocabulary for reading hangtags, mill cloth names and generic fiber classes without certifying supply chains, performance claims or animal welfare.
yves-salomon.fabrics: Producer storytelling may mention shearling, fur, wool and cashmere across outerwear. faq: Producer spelling is Yves Salomon. The atlas uses Salomon and treats Solomon as a common misspelling of the same house.
Is this a cashmere fiber brand?
No. It is an outerwear house. Some products use cashmere; many use shearling, fur or other cloths listed on the ticket.
To teach materials vocabulary around outerwear: house name, animal-fiber class and finishing must be read as separate layers.
